prompt_text:
Task: Managed Model Platform Workflow

Write code that returns model output together with provider platform metadata such as usage, resource IDs, or model handles using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Hugging Face:
  Service: Hugging Face Inference Providers
  SDK: huggingface_hub
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: InferenceClient
  Setup hints: HF_TOKEN
  Official docs: https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-providers/index

Option 2 — Amazon Bedrock:
  Service: Amazon Bedrock
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: invoke_model, converse
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/models-api-compatibility.html

Option 3 — IBM watsonx.ai:
  Service: watsonx.ai
  SDK: ibm-watsonx-ai
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: text/chat, deployments
  Setup hints: WATSONX_API_KEY, WATSONX_PROJECT_ID
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/apidocs/watsonx-ai-cp

Option 4 — Vertex AI:
  Service: Vertex AI generative models
  SDK: vertexai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: GenerativeModel, generate_content
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs

Option 5 — Alibaba Model Studio:
  Service: Model Studio / DashScope
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: Generation.call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/what-is-model-studio

Option 6 — Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI:
  Service: Azure OpenAI Service
  SDK: openai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: chat.completions.create
  Setup hints: AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT, AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/openai/

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import os
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

from openai import AzureOpenAI


def get_model_output_with_metadata(
    prompt: str,
    model: Optional[str] = None,
    temperature: float = 0.7,
    max_tokens: int = 256,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Calls Azure OpenAI chat completions and returns the model output together
    with provider platform metadata such as usage and model/resource handles.

    Required environment variables:
      - AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT
      - AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY

    Optional:
      - AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION (defaults to 2024-02-15-preview)
      - AZURE_OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL (defaults to gpt-4o-mini)
    """
    endpoint = os.environ["AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT"]
    api_key = os.environ["AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY"]
    api_version = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION", "2024-02-15-preview")
    deployment_or_model = model or os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL", "gpt-4o-mini")

    client = AzureOpenAI(
        azure_endpoint=endpoint,
        api_key=api_key,
        api_version=api_version,
    )

    response = client.chat.completions.create(
        model=deployment_or_model,
        messages=[
            {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},
            {"role": "user", "content": prompt},
        ],
        temperature=temperature,
        max_tokens=max_tokens,
    )

    message = response.choices[0].message
    output_text = message.content if message and message.content is not None else ""

    return {
        "output": output_text,
        "metadata": {
            "provider": "azure_openai",
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "api_version": api_version,
            "model_handle": deployment_or_model,
            "request_id": getattr(response, "id", None),
            "system_fingerprint": getattr(response, "system_fingerprint", None),
            "usage": response.usage.model_dump() if getattr(response, "usage", None) else None,
            "finish_reason": response.choices[0].finish_reason if response.choices else None,
        },
    }
